ns2:section.sectionText: [Expanded title: Local, Regional and Global Intersections in Library and Information Science] Replaces LIS 590IL (Global Perspectives inLIS) which was originally scheduled in Spring 2012. Students who were enrolled in LIS 590IL have been transferred to LIS 590GL. If you have questions contact Assistant Dean Rae Montague (rae@illinois.edu) who is also the instructor.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MA:African Studies -UIUC, CAS:Library & Infor Sci -UIUC, MS:Library & Infor Sci -UIUC, or PHD:Library & Infor Sci -UIUC.
